basis.note: A number in a pack is a signed decimal integer from -2147483648 to 2147483647, as Android always read it. A larger one is a format error and only its line or file is skipped; one that fits but is outside the pack is a range error. The platforms differed: iOS read numbers up to 64 bits and the web any number, so the same value was a range error there, and the web rounded numbers past 2^53.
